note: Commercially he is a textbook fit: founded a business with his wife, sold it to a public company last year, semi-retired, and volunteers 'I have money, I have a good life.' On every health-side criterion he is the case the stated ICP explicitly excludes. Health is not the neglected area, it is an active crisis — PTSD with recurrent depressive episodes, three failed surgeries for bilateral compartment syndrome and popliteal entrapment, chronic pain managed with heavily sedating medication, and a GLP-1 about to start. He is roughly 70 lb above his own target at 112 kg wanting 75-80 kg, describes the goal as 'just not to be the fatty', and has yo-yoed between 74 and 130 kg for fifteen years. That is rescue, not good-to-great, and it maps almost word for word onto the stated exclusion: 'It's not like we have dudes who come here who are 50 pounds overweight, who are just like, I need to just lose weight.' Recorded as outside rather than edge because three of five criteria fail and the two that fail hardest are the exclusion tests themselves. Worth noting for the rollup that this reads harder against the criteria than the assessment already on file for the 07/18 call with the same prospect, which credited good_to_great; the divergence is on starting point, and the transcript evidence here is that he is nowhere near good.
